fichas.title: Optically variable glass
fichas.summary: Double-glazed units with adjustable transmission are either switching units, which react automatically to influences such as temperature, or switchable units, whose visual transmittance can be changed by altering the gas layer or applying voltage. Thermotropic units reversibly change from clear to opaque as temperature changes. Electrochromatic units use voltage-responsive layers; liquid-crystal foils are described for interior use, while ion-based systems are suitable for external glazing.
uses: External glazing using ion-based electrochromatic systems

fichas.title: Cast glass: properties and available sizes
fichas.summary: Cast glass is mechanically produced by rolling surface structures and is not clear to look through. It is used where obscure glazing is needed, such as bathrooms and WCs, and as a design element. It is available in several finishes and can be further processed into toughened glass, laminated safety glass, or insulated glazing. Wired glass is generally no longer classified as safety glass, except in specified overhead-glazing cases. The printed table lists thicknesses and maximum pane sizes for DELDOUR® glass types.
uses: Further processing into toughened glass, laminated safety glass, and thermally insulated glazing

fichas.title: Whole glass doors and door elements
fichas.summary: Whole glass doors are toughened-glass panes dimensioned to correspond to metal door linings and may be installed in metal linings produced to DIN 18111. When violently smashed, the glass breaks into a network of small fragments that remain more or less loosely together. Whole glass door elements may combine one or more doors with side elements and a fanlight; sliding, folding, segmented-arch, and round-arch configurations are also described. The tables give maximum toughened-pane sizes and door-element dimensions by nominal size group.
uses: Interior or exterior door installations in compatible metal linings
Whole glass door elements with side elements and fanlights
